# Lib.image.fx.blur

## Operators

- [**Bloom**](Bloom.md) — A more versatile and faster version of [Glow].
- [**Blur**](Blur.md) — Blurs the incoming image
- [**DirectionalBlur**](DirectionalBlur.md) — Blurs the incoming image along a directional angle.
- [**FastBlur**](FastBlur.md) — Provides better quality and much faster speed that the [Blur] but does only allow radius control.
- [**Sharpen**](Sharpen.md) — Sharpens the incoming image.
